name: RateMate – Product Reviews for WooCommerce
author: webtendhq

sections.description:
RateMate is a lightweight, conversion-focused product review plugin for WooCommerce stores. It supercharges the default WooCommerce review system with powerful features that competitors charge for — all in the free version.

🌟 Why RateMate?

Most review plugins lock photo uploads, automated emails, and rich snippets behind expensive Pro plans. RateMate gives you everything you need to build trust and boost conversions — for free.

✅ Features

📸 Photo & Video Reviews
Let customers attach photos and videos directly to their reviews. Nothing builds trust faster than real customer media. Supports JPEG, PNG, GIF, WebP images and MP4/WebM videos. Clean drag-and-drop dropzone with live preview.

⭐ Rating Summary Bar
Show a beautiful star-distribution breakdown (5★ 60%, 4★ 25%…) above your review list. Customers can click any row to filter reviews by that rating — powered by AJAX for instant results.

✉️ Automated Review Request Emails
Automatically send review request emails N days after an order is marked complete. Uses WordPress native mail — no third-party dependency. Fully customizable subject line and send delay. Built-in unsubscribe link for compliance.

🛡️ Verified Purchase Badge
Reviews from real WooCommerce customers automatically get a “Verified Purchase” badge. Builds trust instantly. Works with both logged-in users and guest checkouts.

👍 Helpfulness Votes
“Was this review helpful?” vote buttons on every review. Counts are tracked per-user/IP. The most-helpful reviews rise to the top organically. No registration required for guests.

🔍 Google Rich Snippets (Schema Markup)
Automatically outputs JSON-LD schema for aggregate ratings and individual reviews. Enable Google to show star ratings directly in search results — free organic visibility boost.

🚀 Perfect For

  • WooCommerce store owners who want more reviews
  • Stores launching new products (review request emails drive early reviews)
  • Agencies building high-converting WooCommerce stores
  • Dropshippers and Amazon FBA sellers moving to their own store

🔒 Privacy & Compliance

  • One-click email unsubscribe included
  • No data sent to external services
  • GDPR-friendly: all data stored locally in your WordPress database

⚡ Performance First

  • Assets loaded only on product pages
  • AJAX-powered filtering — no full page reloads
  • Minimal database queries with proper indexing
  • No bloat — only what you need
sections.installation:
1. Upload the ratemate folder to /wp-content/plugins/
  2. Activate the plugin from Plugins → Installed Plugins
  3. Ensure WooCommerce is installed and active
  4. Go to RateMate → Settings to configure features
sections.faq:
Does this replace the default WooCommerce review system?

No. RateMate enhances and extends the WooCommerce review system — it does not replace it. All existing reviews are preserved.

Will review request emails be sent for old orders?

No. Emails are only queued for orders that transition to “Completed” after the plugin is activated.

Can customers upload multiple photos?

Yes. You can configure the maximum number of uploads (1–20) and maximum file size in RateMate → Settings → Photo Reviews.

Does the plugin work with variable products?

Yes. The plugin is fully compatible with WooCommerce variable products.

Is this plugin compatible with WooCommerce HPOS?

Yes. RateMate declares full compatibility with WooCommerce High-Performance Order Storage (HPOS / custom order tables).

Where are uploaded photos stored?

Photos and videos are stored in your WordPress Media Library — the same place as all other media uploads. They are linked to the specific product post.
